text: ▶ Apple, Google, and Amazon Join List Of Companies Opposing Trump Admin's Rollback Of Transgender Rights 00:33 The Trump administration is proposing a legal definition of sex as male or female based on an individual's sex at birth. On Thursday, more than 50 companies signed a letter opposing any such actions by the administration, says Business Insider. The signatories included tech giants like Apple, Google... You Might Like
